scientific_intent.scientific_task: Apply a momentum-based approximately orthogonalized update to a2D hidden-layer weight matrix, testing BF16 working precision and tall/wide orientation.
scientific_intent.governing_method: Five-step quintic Newton-Schulz polynomial with Frobenius normalization and spectral aspect-ratio scaling.
accuracy_needs: Both transposed and nontransposed working matrices
Dense and diagonal controlled singular-value fixtures
Separate finite-step polynomial/quantization approximation from cross-port arithmetic

reference_repair.finding: Historical Julia implements the same idealized momentum/Newton-Schulz update using allFP32 working matrices, while native uses BF16 storage and rounding after each NS stage. This is a P1 precision/mapping fidelity compromise, not an established wrong idealized optimizer or observed historical failure. Named reference restores actual source BF16 pipeline, vector4 work assignment, fused transposes and explicit vendor GEMM ABI.
